title: 中国人民银行副行长陈德霖：香港首度纳入五年规划，政策支持金融枢纽
speaker: Chen Derling

segments.en: The first time Hong Kong will have the first five-year plan and integrate itself to the master development of the mainland China and then inject more vitality to the market.
segments.zh: 香港首次拥有五年规划，融入国家发展大局，为市场注入更多活力。

segments.en: The macro policy as the stability, the monetary policy turns to be supportive, the financial policy is beneficiary to the industry development. The Chinese financial market and internationalization of R&B are ongoing.
segments.zh: 宏观政策保持稳定，货币政策转向支持，金融政策利好产业发展。中国金融市场和人民币国际化持续推进。

segments.en: It is an opportunity for Hong Kong as the international currency system is going to be diversified and the speed is getting faster. The demand for R&B is growth from the settlement to financing and reserve and pricing.
segments.zh: 国际货币体系多元化加速，香港迎来机遇。人民币需求从结算扩展到融资、储备和定价。

segments.en: Hong Kong as the window and the trail area for opening up to the world, Hong Kong attracts enterprises from the overseas market, invest in the mainland market and Hong Kong's attractiveness in this regard will only go higher.
segments.zh: 香港作为对外开放的窗口和试验田，吸引海外企业投资内地市场，其吸引力将持续提升。

segments.en: President Xi speaks at the 25th anniversary of Hong Kong's return to the motherland and addresses the determination to ensure Hong Kong's stability and build Hong Kong as the hub in many industries and safeguard the openness and freedom in Hong Kong and also the enabling environment for business.
segments.zh: 习近平主席在香港回归25周年讲话中，决心确保香港稳定，打造多行业枢纽，维护开放自由和营商环境。
